title: 14 days to an AI engineering interview
intro: One sitting a day, 25-45 minutes. Run each drill in interview mode with the timer armed before you look at the hints. Days 7 and 14 are re-runs of drills you have already solved, which is the point: the second attempt is the one that tells you whether it stuck.

days.title: Decoding
days.focus: What temperature, top_k and top_p actually do to the distribution.

days.title: Attention
days.focus: Write it in numpy and defend the square root.

days.title: Tokenizers
days.focus: The merge loop, and why your model cannot count letters.

days.title: Chunking
days.focus: The first thing every RAG pipeline does, and the first thing it gets wrong.

days.title: Lexical search
days.focus: BM25 from the formula. Know what k1 and b do.

days.title: Hybrid retrieval
days.focus: Fusing rankings whose scores are not comparable.

days.title: Retrieval, timed
days.focus: Re-run the week under interview mode. No hints.

days.title: Reliability
days.focus: The 429 handler you will write at every job you ever have.

days.title: Streaming
days.focus: Chunk boundaries are not frame boundaries.

days.title: Structured output
days.focus: Parse first, repair second. Never the other way round.

days.title: Agents
days.focus: An agent is a while loop with a budget and two failure paths.

days.title: Scoring
days.focus: The SQuAD scorer, and why token F1 falls apart on generation.

days.title: Safety
days.focus: Heuristic injection detection, and calibrating a threshold.

days.title: Mock round
days.focus: Three drills back to back, timed, cold. This is the real rehearsal.
